subject: how to use time in hourly time-step?

messages.author: 4c1108aaddb5744d
messages.subject: how to use time in hourly time-step?
parts:
Dear ggplot users,

I want to ask that how to draw time in hourly time-step? That is to say, the data is in such a format, 1/1/09 00:00, 1/1/09 01:00, 1/1/09 02:00, 1/1/09 03:00, etc. The time will be used as x-axis. The y-axis has hourly temperature data.
When I use geom_point, the x-axis has just one thick line, but no data shows.
When I use geom_path, it has the warning "geom_path: Each group consist of only one observation. Do you need to adjust the group aesthetic?"

My code is like this:
temp = ggplot()+
 geom_path(data=sourcedata,aes(x=time,y=temperature,color="temperature"))+
  xlab('Time')+ylab('Time at hourly time-step')
show(temp)

Thanks very much for your help.
